course.title: Statistics for Planners-I
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: According to a survey, the probability that a family owns a car if its monthly household income is greater than BDT 100000 is 0.75. Of the households surveyed, 60% had incomes over BDT 100000 and 52% had a car. A family is randomly selected; Find out the probability that the family has a car and an income over BDT 100000 monthly.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
